title: Maximal Seshadri constants on arbitrary polarized surfaces

abstractEnglish: We prove that, for every smooth integral complex projective surface S and every ample line bundle L, the multipoint Seshadri constant at r very general points equals $`\sqrt{L^2/r}`$ for every sufficiently large integer r. This resolves positively the qualitative Nagata–Biran conjecture for surfaces.
